I rolled back checkout-api and opened the incident.

**What I did:**
1. Confirmed checkout-api was unhealthy (error rate ~18%) on v2.3.1 across all regions.
2. Identified v2.3.0 as the most recent version that was healthy in production.
3. Rolled back to v2.3.0 in all regions. The first attempt hit a partial failure (orchestrator error after us-east), so I retried and the rollout completed to us-east, us-west, and eu-west.
4. Verified the service is now healthy (error rate ~0.2%).
5. Opened SEV2 incident **INC-0002** describing the rollback and the partial-failure retry.
